rules.message: The value '*' provided to the cast expression is not in the valid range of values for 'Capability'
rules.rationale: Capability is an explicitly uint8_t-backed flags type. operator| forms only combinations of the three declared bits, normalize_capabilities tests those bits, and no value is used as an enum discriminator. The analyzer models only named enumerators and therefore rejects valid flag combinations.

rules.message: The value '*' provided to the cast expression is not in the valid range of values for 'IoInterest'
rules.rationale: IoInterest is an explicitly uint8_t-backed two-bit flags type. The only constructed combination is read|write and consumers inspect individual bits; the analyzer treats the flags type as a closed discriminator.

rules.message: The value '*' provided to the cast expression is not in the valid range of values for 'IoFlags'
rules.rationale: IoFlags is an explicitly uint8_t-backed four-bit flags type populated by the poller backends. operator| combines only declared bits and every consumer uses has_flag; the analyzer cannot represent unnamed but valid bit combinations.

rules.message: an exception may be thrown in function 'install_writer_generation' which should not throw exceptions
rules.rationale: Every Lane reserves kMaximumRetiredReadGenerations cells during construction. Admission is checked immediately before push_back, shared_ptr copy/move is non-throwing, and a contract breach terminates before publication. clang-tidy does not propagate the reserved-capacity invariant across callers.

rules.message: Call to blocking function 'recv' inside of critical section
rules.rationale: The per-worker connection mutex deliberately serializes a complete request/response exchange so frames cannot be consumed by the wrong caller. The socket is nonblocking; EAGAIN is delegated to a poll wait bounded by request_timeout_ms, and the critical section acquires no other lock.

rules.message: uninitialized record type: 'chunk'
rules.rationale: recv or the TLS read overwrites a prefix of chunk and the code appends exactly that returned prefix. No byte outside the initialized prefix is observed; zeroing the full 64 KiB transport scratch buffer on every iteration would add work without changing safety.

rules.message: an exception may be thrown in function 'close_connection' which should not throw exceptions
rules.rationale: Poller removal is contained by catch-all, connection members have non-throwing reset/clear operations, and free_slots is reserved to maximum_connections and receives each live slot at most once. The analyzer cannot infer the slot-capacity and lifecycle invariant.

rules.message: function is not thread safe
rules.rationale: The readdir call operates on a function-local DIR stream created from a freshly opened descriptor and never shared between threads. The name-based check cannot distinguish independent streams from concurrent access to one stream.

rules.message: function is not thread safe
rules.rationale: Namespace audit owns a fresh function-local DIR stream for the full enumeration and never publishes it. The name-based check cannot distinguish independent streams from concurrent access to one stream.

rules.message: function is not thread safe
rules.rationale: These three getenv calls run during single-threaded daemon configuration before Store or server worker threads start. The process does not mutate its environment after startup; the analyzer does not model this lifecycle boundary.

rules.message: function is not thread safe
rules.rationale: The default environment lookup is used while parsing daemon configuration before worker creation. Production does not mutate the process environment after startup, and tests inject a lookup instead of racing setenv with this function.

rules.message: an exception may be thrown in function '*' which should not throw exceptions
rules.rationale: Lane slot and free-index vectors are sized/reserved at construction and capacity is checked before reuse. The worker catches allocation and arbitrary task failures into a default-constructed Error, while both index queues require nothrow-movable elements. clang-tidy does not carry these capacity and element-trait invariants.

rules.message: integer to pointer cast pessimizes optimization opportunities
rules.rationale: The kqueue kevent ABI exposes udata as an opaque void pointer. GlyphaStore round-trips the uint64 connection token through uintptr_t without dereferencing it; the cast is the platform ABI boundary and is guarded by pointer-width static assertions.

rules.message: an exception may be thrown in function '*' which should not throw exceptions
rules.rationale: free_slots is reserved to slot_capacity at construction; rollback/release validate ownership and sequence, check capacity before push_back, and return each occupied slot exactly once. clang-tidy does not infer that push_back cannot grow the vector.

rules.message: an exception may be thrown in function 'process_sync_lane' which should not throw exceptions
rules.rationale: All std::function hooks are constructed inside the surrounding try block from non-throwing targets before use; construction failure arms fail-closed state and returns. Bounded vectors are reserved before Store entry. The checker treats std::function invocation as an arbitrary throwing call.

rules.message: an exception may be thrown in function 'operator()' which should not throw exceptions
rules.rationale: The diagnostic points to shadow_resolve_status. Its only potentially throwing expression is Status::error(), reached exclusively in the false branch of Status::operator bool(); for Result<void>, false is exactly the invariant that the optional Error is engaged. The checker does not propagate that class invariant through the branch.
